channel.title: Veronica Hub Changelog
channel.description: Independent tracker for official Resident Evil Veronica updates official update feed.

item.title: Homepage copy refreshed in English and Japanese
item.description: Refreshed the English and Japanese homepage copy with Gemini-assisted drafts while preserving the confirmed 2027 release window, platform facts and unknown-detail boundaries.

item.title: SEO copy refresh for source-tracked pages
item.description: Refreshed the English editorial copy across the release, platform, story, media and status pages using Gemini-assisted drafts while preserving source-backed facts and unknown-detail boundaries. No official game fact was changed.

item.title: September review: Spotlight scheduled, Veronica participation unconfirmed
item.description: Added Capcom's September 1 event announcement without treating it as a Veronica reveal. Checked stores still show 2027 and TBD PC requirements. Preserved the August wishlist record and its earlier verification date. Reference: Capcom TGS 2026 announcement (September 1) (https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000005996.000013450.html).

item.title: News, gameplay and original-game dossiers added
item.description: Added a news center, a source-checked Spotlight explainer, gameplay, enemy and boss guides, and six character dossiers. Original-story spoilers are opt-in. This is site content, not a new Capcom game announcement.

item.title: Four more blog guides: versions, Rockfort, family and beginner tips
item.description: Published four original English features and expanded the Blog to ten posts. Preserved the first six articles; classic-game tips and optional story spoilers remain separate from remake announcements.

item.title: Blog opens with six independent Veronica features
item.description: Added a separate Blog with six features covering the camera, title, preparation, Claire’s design, the story timeline and original monsters. Connected navigation, search, article schemas and source links. This is an editorial expansion, not a new Capcom announcement.

item.title: Two-million wishlist milestone added and official stores rechecked
item.description: Added the official Resident Evil account's August 4 two-million-wishlist milestone. A fresh review of Capcom, Steam, PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo still shows a 2027 release window with no exact release date; Steam PC requirements remain TBD, and no preorder timing, price, editions or demo are confirmed. Reference: Official Resident Evil two-million wishlist milestone (https://x.com/RE_Games/status/2084455588088435103).

item.title: Homepage facts rechecked against official sources
item.description: Capcom's announcement and the Steam, Xbox and Nintendo product pages still confirm the 2027 release window, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2 and PC platforms, and the absence of an exact release date, price, preorder, demo and PC requirements. No new game announcement was found. Reference: Capcom press release (https://www.capcom.co.jp/ir/english/news/html/e260608.html).

item.title: Producer comments add lore continuity and Wesker context
item.description: Added producer-attributed PlayStation Blog context on story retuning, third-person direction, remake-team continuity and the story importance of Albert Wesker alongside Claire and Chris. Reference: PlayStation Blog Summer Game Fest report (https://blog.playstation.com/2026/06/08/summer-game-fest-2026-hands-on-and-more-details-on-11-upcoming-ps5-games/).

item.title: Conflicting Xbox age-rating metadata recorded
item.description: The Xbox page displays a Mature 17+ badge and content descriptors while its own description still says the content has not yet been age-rated. The site records the display as unresolved rather than a confirmed final rating. Reference: Xbox Store (https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/resident-evil-veronica/9pjjk03lkjkb).

item.title: Official platform store links and wishlist milestone added
item.description: Added direct Steam, PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo store links, recorded official platform feature flags, and added Capcom's one-million-wishlist milestone with sales and preorder caveats. Reference: Official Resident Evil wishlist milestone (https://bsky.app/profile/residentevil.capcomusa.com/post/3mny6lxm2uk2t).

item.title: Producer interview details added
item.description: Added reported producer-interview and media Q&A details covering third-person camera direction, title rationale, remake-team context, Claire story focus and the continued lack of an exact release date. Reference: VGC producer interview (https://www.videogameschronicle.com/features/resident-evil-veronica-producer-explains-why-it-deserves-a-remake-and-is-just-as-important-as-numbered-entries/).

item.title: Official video library added
item.description: Added verified official Resident Evil Veronica video uploads from Resident Evil, BIOHAZARD, Official Capcom Europe, PlayStation, Xbox and Summer Game Fest.

item.title: Official research pass adds product-page and Steam fact coverage
item.description: Expanded source coverage with the official Resident Evil Veronica product page, English official trailer, Steam story premise, remake positioning, feature flags and TBD PC requirements.

item.title: Watchlist and RSS tracking layer added
item.description: Added the Watchlist page and RSS feed so readers can follow official information changes.

item.title: Initial site structure added
item.description: Added core pages for release date, platforms, trailer, sources and update history.

item.title: Expanded playable reference catalog with pre-2000 RE era titles
item.description: Added original and early-series Resident Evil titles plus additional clip search references so visitors can compare pacing before judging Veronica.

item.title: Homepage visual direction improved
item.description: The homepage hero and official media presentation were refined while preserving the lead heroine background.

item.title: Steam page is live
item.description: Steam lists Resident Evil Veronica with CAPCOM as developer and publisher and a planned 2027 release year. Reference: Steam store (https://store.steampowered.com/app/4824610/Resident_Evil_Veronica/).

item.title: Capcom announces Resident Evil Veronica for 2027
item.description: Capcom announces Resident Evil Veronica as a remake with a 2027 release window and confirmed platform set. Reference: Capcom press release (https://www.capcom.co.jp/ir/english/news/html/e260608.html).
